generated_questions.question: is_prime function ka logic explain karo, kaise ye decide karta hai ki koi number prime hai ya nahi, aur har step ka purpose kya hai?
generated_questions.reference_answer: Function sabse pehle check karta hai ki number 2 se chhota hai ya nahi (lines 3‑4). Agar hai to turant False return hota hai, kyunki prime numbers ki definition ke mutabik 2 se kam koi bhi integer prime nahi hota. Phir divisor ko 2 se initialise kiya jata hai aur while loop chalaya jata hai jab tak divisor ka square (divisor * divisor) number se chhota ya barabar hota hai (line 6). Ye condition isliye use hoti hai kyunki agar number ka koi factor sqrt(number) se bada hoga to uska complementary factor sqrt(number) se chhota hoga, isliye sqrt tak hi check karna sufficient hai. Loop ke andar har iteration mein number % divisor se remainder check kiya jata hai (line 7). Agar remainder zero ho to iska matlab divisor number ka exact factor hai, isliye function False return karta hai. Agar remainder zero nahi hota to divisor ko 1 se badhaya jata hai (line 9) aur next possible factor test hota hai. Jab tak loop finish ho jata hai aur koi divisor nahi milta, tab function line 10 par True return karta hai, jo indicate karta hai ki number prime hai.

rubric.description: Explain the handling of numbers less than 2 and why the function returns False immediately.
Describe the purpose of the while loop condition `divisor * divisor <= number`.
Detail the modulo check and divisor increment inside the loop, and how they detect non‑prime numbers.
State why the final `return True` is reached only when no divisor was found.
